explanation: Green's Problem 43: for every choice of residues a(p) for primes p ∈ [N^{0.51}, 2N^{0.51}), the number of n ∈ [N] hitting some class is ≥ N^{1−ε} for every ε and all large N. This is the standard ∀ε reading of "≫ N^{1−o(1)}", uniform over the choice a. sievedSet is correctly defined. The statement is faithful.
